notes.text: ported from vulnerability-match-labels 225c8d61-f3fe-45e2-9b08-f51750b0cc4b: fp with grype[reference]@v0.111.0. Was CVE-2021-3580. Installed gnutls 3.6.16-4.el8 is exactly the fixed version from ELSA-2021-4451 (CVE-2021-20231, CVE-2021-20232, CVE-2021-3580). This match comes from ELSA-2022-9221, the FIPS build of gnutls. Oracle's OVAL for it applies only when the installed gnutls release matches 'fips' ('gnutls is fips patched') and is earlier than 10:3.6.16-4.0.1.el8_fips; the build changed its epoch from 1 to 10 (changelog). This package's release has no 'fips', and without that check epoch 10 makes every non-FIPS build compare as vulnerable. Evidence: https://linux.oracle.com/errata/ELSA-2021-4451.html https://linux.oracle.com/errata/ELSA-2022-9221.html https://linux.oracle.com/oval/com.oracle.elsa-20229221.xml
